data.title: Coffee drink
data.statement:
Draw a cup of coffee after [[n]] ml has been drunk.

The cup has a fixed shape and initially contains {{250}}ml of coffee divided into five equal-volume levels. Each liquid row represents exactly {{50}} ml of coffee, regardless of the cup's shape. Empty space inside and outside the cup is represented using space characters, and trailing spaces at the end of each line should be removed.

The coffee's type can be espresso or cappuccino and is represented with the character {{.}} . If the type is <<cappuccino>>, the top row of the remaining coffee consists of {{~}} instead.
`
espresso:       cappuccino:
 #...........#   #~~~~~~~~~~~#
 #...........#   #...........#
  #.........#     #.........#
   #.......#       #.......#
    #.....#         #.....#
     #####           #####
`

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Draw a cup of coffee after n ml has been drunk.

The cup has a fixed shape and initially contains 250ml of coffee divided into five equal-volume levels. Each liquid row represents exactly 50 ml of coffee, regardless of the cup's shape. Empty space inside and outside the cup is represented using space characters, and trailing spaces at the end of each line should be removed.

The coffee's type can be espresso or cappuccino and is represented with the character . . If the type is cappuccino, the top row of the remaining coffee consists of ~ instead.

espresso:       cappuccino:
 #...........#   #~~~~~~~~~~~#
 #...........#   #...........#
  #.........#     #.........#
   #.......#       #.......#
    #.....#         #.....#
     #####           #####
Input
Line 1: An integer n for the amount of coffee drunk in ml.
Line 2: A string type espresso or cappuccino.
Output
6 lines: ASCII characters representing the cup and the remaining coffee.
Constraints
0 <= n <= 250
n is a multiple of 50
Example
Input
0
espresso
Output
#...........#
#...........#
 #.........#
  #.......#
   #.....#
    #####
